subject: Web Development
title: Prototype, MooTools, and Rivals
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Prototype, MooTools, and Rivals.

hook.text: jQuery wasn't the only library trying to fix the browser. It had fierce competition.

buildup.text: Prototype and MooTools extended JavaScript's built-in objects with new convenience methods.

discovery.text: Both were popular and elegant, especially for developers who liked Ruby-style syntax.

twist.text: Extending built-in objects created conflicts. Two libraries modifying Array broke each other.

climax.text: jQuery's non-invasive approach won. It never modified global objects and played nicely.

punchline.text: The safest library outlasted the cleverest ones.

quiz.question: Why did Prototype and MooTools cause problems?
